description: Find the people who commented on and/or reacted to (liked, celebrated, etc.) a specific LinkedIn post, from its URL. Use this when the user already has a post in mind; to discover posts by topic, use precept_get_leads_from_post_search instead. Each result is one person, with their reaction and comment merged into one row: full_name, headline, linkedin (profile URL), user_name, profile_picture, profile_type ('individual' or 'organization'), engagement_types (['reaction'], ['comment'] or both), reaction_type (LinkedIn's names: LIKE = Like, PRAISE = Celebrate, APPRECIATION = Support, EMPATHY = Love, INTEREST = Insightful, ENTERTAINMENT = Funny; null if they only commented), comment_text, commented_at (ISO timestamp), comment_reply_count and is_comment_reply (comment fields are null for people who only reacted; LinkedIn doesn't expose when a reaction was made). Commenters are listed first, then reactors. People who only reacted often have an ID-style profile URL (linkedin.com/in/ACoAA...) instead of a public username; it still opens their profile. The completed job also includes summary counts (total_engagers, reactors, commenters) and the credits charged. Returns up to 100 people by default; pass limit for more (max 1000). Uses 0.5 credits per person returned (the same base rate as precept_search_leads); if the balance covers fewer people than the limit, fewer are returned. precept_check_credits shows the balance. Runs asynchronously and returns an enrichment_id (jobId). Check progress with precept_get_job_status; these jobs usually finish within a minute, so checking every ~4 seconds works well. Results work well as a table (Name, Headline, Engagement, Reaction, Comment, Commented At, LinkedIn). Users often follow up by enriching people with precept_enrich_leads, messaging them with precept_linkedin_messages, or queuing them into a campaign with precept_campaign_queue.

engagementTypes.description: Which engagers to collect: 'reactions' (likes and other reactions) and/or 'comments'. Default: both.

includeCommentReplies.description: Also include people who replied to other comments (is_comment_reply is true for them). Default: false.

limit.description: Maximum number of people to return (max 1000). Defaults to 100. Commenters fill the limit first, then reactors.

name.description: A readable name for this job.

postUrl.description: The LinkedIn post to read engagement from: a post URL (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/posts/... or https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:...), an lnkd.in short link, an activity URN (urn:li:activity:...) or a post ID.

name: precept_get_post_engagers

outputSchema.description: Initialization response containing the jobId to poll for results

enrichment_id.description: The unique job ID to poll with precept_get_job_status

finalLimit.description: Adjusted limit based on available credit balance

message.description: Status message describing the initialized job

title: Post Commenters & Reactors
